name: Goblin Warrior
_comment: SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0), Goblin Warrior. AC 15 comes from the gear (Leather Armor 11 + Dex 2 + Shield 2); to-hit +4 and 1d6 + 2 damage from Dexterity, PB +2 and the weapons. Not yet modelled: the extra 1d4 damage on an attack roll with Advantage and Nimble Escape (both Milestone 5, U22); Darkvision, Hide and the senses (out of scope).
